original.statement: Deprecated Helm options encryption.{keyFile,mountPath,secretName,interface} are removed in Cilium 1.16.0 and replaced by encryption.ipsec.* options.

decision.reason: [ev-5d3c6d3080f0] says all four Helm options, encryption.keyFile, encryption.mountPath, encryption.secretName and encryption.interface, are removed in favor of encryption.ipsec.*. So an environment is exposed when it sets any one of them. The proposed any-of over values-key{path, set} follows the canonical helm-value/removed shape for each key. The values diff [ev-28e0ccb5774a, ev-39a22d88e2f5] confirms that encryption.keyFile was removed. The canonical-shape check differs only because the condition covers all four keys, not just the subject's keyFile. Covering all four matches the scope of the upstream statement, so the condition is not broader than it should be.
